finding: While the nasopharyngeal microbiota rapidly develops within one day of birth regardless of delivery mode, infants born by Caesarean section show a delay in the overall development of respiratory microbiota profiles, particularly with reduced colonization of beneficial bacteria like Corynebacterium and Dolosigranulum, potentially impacting respiratory health later in life.
mod_finding: Infants born by Caesarean section showed a delay in overall development of respiratory microbiota profiles with specifically reduced colonization with health-associated commensals like Corynebacterium and Dolosigranulum.
